messages:
Priya: Final sync — Orbiton reserved pool bring-up TOMORROW 07:30 UTC. Baseline quota 200k tokens/min, burst to 300k. Pool target = 6x gpus (equiv). Need SRE + Runtime + CS on call. This thread = ops checklist + owners.

Jon: On it. Autoscale plan: metric=token_rate_per_node, target_util=0.6, min_replicas=3, max_replicas=10, scale_cooldown=90s. I'll push policy and test in staging tonight.

Sasha: Suggested latency SLOs: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms. If we see sustained p95 > 700ms for 3m, trigger host fallback. Canary at 5% to quantized variant (orbiton-q4).

Carla: Orbiton engineering will run their warmup runner at 06:40 UTC and rotate keys at 07:00 UTC. They've asked for a short KMS confirmation and a 15m walkthrough at 07:10 UTC.

Priya: Bring-up timeline (high level):
- 06:00 infra smoke (nodes, storage, network)
- 06:30 pool provisioning verification (node labels, taints)
- 06:40 client warmup start (Orbiton runner)
- 07:00 key/KMS validation + customer readiness call
- 07:30 ramp start: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% over 45m (15m steps)
- 08:20 chaos: evict 1 replica, validate autoscale and fallback handling
- 08:40 90m soak at target load
Load test (k6) sample snippet:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function () {
  http.post(__ENV.TARGET + '/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'summarize', max_tokens: 80}), {headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
}
```
Ramp VUs: 20 -> 200 -> 800 over 45m.

Jon: Alerts I will add: queue_length > 400 (3m), avg_token_latency > 1s (2m), node_mem_pressure true. When alert fires: route 25% to hosted fallback and post incident to #customer-alerts with "orbiton-fallback" tag.

OpsBot: Reminder: "Orbiton reserved pool bring-up" scheduled for 2024-06-15T07:30:00Z — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/reserved-bringup. :bell:

Sasha: Caching notes: enable prefix caching + local KV layer. Ask Orbiton to ensure stable session prefixes; otherwise cache hit rate will be low. Also set model cache TTL=10m for priming.

Carla: Question: if Orbiton hits quota mid-ramp, they want to avoid client errors. Proposal: soft-reroute to hosted + retry semantics 302 + X-Attribution header, plus CS notification and short window of degraded perf allowed (30m) while we warm more capacity. Thoughts?

Jon: That's doable. Policy: if token_rate > quota*0.95 && queue_len>350 => route 30% to hosted, escalate to oncall if sustained >10m. Add hysteresis to prevent flapping.

Priya: Action items: @Jon = push autoscale + alerts + fallback route; @Sasha = canary config + KV warm scripts; @Carla = run KMS check w/ Orbiton + send 07:10 walkthrough invite; @Priya = host war room and coordinate chaos test. War room link posted 20m before start.

Carla: I'll DM Orbiton to confirm SSH access window for debugging and ask for a short list of top-10 endpoints they expect to hit.

Jon: Running a staging dry-run now with a 45m ramp and will post results by EOD. If anyone needs specific telemetry, tell me what to include (latency percentiles, queue, token_rate, mem per node).

Priya: Please tag all priming traffic with header X-Priming: orbiton-v1 so we can filter logs and cost attribution. Also set X-Customer: orbiton.

Sasha: Adding a canary config for runtime team:
```yaml
canary_percent: 5
model: orbiton-q4
fallback_model: orbiton-q8
cache_ttl_seconds: 600
```
Jon: Copy that. I'll ensure the router respects canary weights and fallback priority.

Priya: Thanks all. If anything blocks before midnight ping me. See you tomorrow morning. :rocket:
